#!/bin/bash
# YamzzBot Installation Script for Pterodactyl Panel
set -e

echo "============================================================"
echo "   👑 YAMZZBOT WHATSAPP CALLER - INSTALLATION 👑"
echo "============================================================"

# Update system packages
echo -e "\n📦 Updating system packages..."
apt update
apt install -y git curl jq file unzip make gcc g++ python3 python3-dev libtool ffmpeg wget ca-certificates

# Install Go compiler
echo -e "\n🔧 Installing Go ${GO_VERSION:-1.21.5}..."
GO_VERSION="${GO_VERSION:-1.21.5}"
if ! command -v go &> /dev/null; then
    wget -q https://go.dev/dl/go${GO_VERSION}.linux-amd64.tar.gz
    tar -C /usr/local -xzf go${GO_VERSION}.linux-amd64.tar.gz
    rm go${GO_VERSION}.linux-amd64.tar.gz
fi
export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin
export GOPATH=/home/container/go
export GOCACHE=/home/container/.cache/go-build

echo -e "✅ Go version: $(go version)"

# Navigate to server directory
cd /mnt/server

echo -e "\n📂 Working directory: $(pwd)"

# Handle Git or User Upload
if [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "true" ] || [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "1" ]; then
    echo -e "\n📦 User upload mode - Files will be uploaded manually"
    echo -e "⚠️  Make sure to upload all files including: main.go, index.js, package.json, go.mod"
else
    echo -e "\n📥 Git clone mode..."
    if [ -z "${GIT_ADDRESS}" ]; then
        echo -e "❌ ERROR: GIT_ADDRESS not set!"
        exit 1
    fi
    if [ -d .git ]; then
        echo -e "📥 Pulling latest changes..."
        git pull
    else
        echo -e "📥 Cloning repository: ${GIT_ADDRESS}"
        git clone ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
    fi
fi

# Build Go binary if source exists
if [ -f go.mod ] && [ -f main.go ]; then
    echo -e "\n🔨 Installing Go dependencies..."
    go mod download
    
    echo -e "\n🔨 Building Go binary (yamzzbot)..."
    go build -o yamzzbot .
    
    if [ -f yamzzbot ]; then
        chmod +x yamzzbot
        echo -e "✅ Go binary built successfully: $(ls -lh yamzzbot | awk '{print $5}')"
    else
        echo -e "❌ ERROR: Failed to build Go binary!"
        exit 1
    fi
else
    echo -e "\n⚠️  WARNING: go.mod or main.go not found, skipping Go build"
    echo -e "⚠️  If you're using user upload, make sure to upload yamzzbot binary!"
fi

# Install Node.js dependencies
if [ -f package.json ]; then
    echo -e "\n📦 Installing Node.js dependencies..."
    npm install --production --no-optional
    echo -e "✅ Node.js packages installed"
else
    echo -e "\n⚠️  WARNING: package.json not found, skipping npm install"
fi

# Create necessary directories
echo -e "\n📁 Creating data directories..."
mkdir -p data recordings logs

# Set permissions
echo -e "\n🔐 Setting permissions..."
chmod -R 755 .
if [ -f yamzzbot ]; then
    chmod +x yamzzbot
fi

echo -e "\n============================================================"
echo -e "✅ Installation completed successfully!"
echo -e "============================================================"
echo -e "\n📋 Next steps:"
echo -e "  1. Click START button in Pterodactyl panel"
echo -e "  2. Bot will start and show QR/Pairing code"
echo -e "  3. Scan QR or enter pairing code in WhatsApp"
echo -e "\n🔗 Project files:"
ls -lah | grep -E '(yamzzbot|index.js|package.json|go.mod|main.go|bot_config.json)'
echo -e "\n============================================================\n"
